Custom race music
=================

Put your own .mp3 files in this folder, then turn on
Sound -> "Custom race music" in NeoSMK's menu bar (F1 shows it).

While a race's course music plays, a song from this folder plays instead
(a different one each race, looping). The game's sound effects - engines,
items, Lakitu - stay. The countdown, final-lap and finish music are the
game's own. Sound -> "Race music volume" sets the level.

The folder is read again at the start of every race, so you can add or
remove songs while the game is running.
